title: Single-cell co-mapping reveals relationship between chromatin state and gene expression in early zebrafish development.
authors: Bhardwaj, Vivek; Griffa, Alberto; Vinas Gaza, Helena; Zeller, Peter; van Oudenaarden, Alexander
one_liner_zh: 该文通过单细胞多组学联合检测染色质状态与基因表达，结合可解释机器学习模型分类谱系特异性转录因子，虽涉及TF与染色质互作，但核心是表观调控与表达关联，缺乏TF-DNA三维结合建模或分子互作机制研究，方法可迁移但对象和互作深度有限。
abstract: Establishing a cell type-specific chromatin landscape is crucial for the maintenance of cell identity during embryonic development. However, our knowledge of how this landscape is set during vertebrate embryogenesis has been limited, due to the lack of methods to jointly detect chromatin modifications and gene expression in the same cell. Here we present a multimodal measurement of full-length transcriptome and histone modifications in individual cells during early embryonic development in zebrafish. We show that before the formation of germ layers, the chromatin and transcription states of cells are uncoupled and become progressively connected during gastrulation and somitogenesis. Silencing of developmental genes is achieved by local spreading of repressive chromatin together with cell type-specific demethylation. Combining transcription factor (TF) expression and chromatin states within an interpretable machine learning model, we classify TFs as lineage-specific activators and repressors and identify a subset of TFs that are epigenetically regulated. Altogether, our data resolves the dynamic relationship between chromatin and transcription during early vertebrate development and clarifies how these two layers interact to establish cell identity.
abstract_zh: 建立细胞类型特异性的染色质景观对于胚胎发育过程中细胞身份的维持至关重要。然而，由于缺乏在同一细胞中联合检测染色质修饰和基因表达的方法，我们对脊椎动物胚胎发生过程中这一景观如何建立的认识一直有限。在此，我们展示了斑马鱼早期胚胎发育过程中单细胞内全长转录组和组蛋白修饰的多模态测量。我们发现，在胚层形成之前，细胞的染色质和转录状态是解耦的，并在原肠胚形成和体节发生过程中逐渐连接起来。发育基因的沉默通过抑制性染色质的局部扩散以及细胞类型特异性的去甲基化实现。将转录因子（TF）表达和染色质状态结合在一个可解释的机器学习模型中，我们将TF分类为谱系特异性的激活因子和抑制因子，并识别出一组受表观遗传调控的TF。总体而言，我们的数据解析了早期脊椎动物发育过程中染色质与转录之间的动态关系，并阐明了这两层如何相互作用以建立细胞身份。
